## 🔥 Campfire — Free LAN Hosting for Minecraft
Open your singleplayer Minecraft world to friends instantly over the internet without port forwarding or rented servers.

✨ **Highlights**
• **Direct P2P & UPnP** with automatic relay fallback
• **Instant Invite Codes** (`CAMP-XXXXX-XXXXX`)
• **Friends & Live Presence HUD**
• ⚡ **Infrastructure Powered by Enzonic**
